title: NASA TP-1906 Table 11.3E CHON + graphite heterogeneous equilibrium enthalpy

source.name: NASA Technical Paper 1906
source.citation: S. Gordon, Thermodynamic and Transport Combustion Properties of Hydrocarbons with Air, Part I: Properties Corresponding to Equilibrium Compositions in Part II

transcription: Rows were transcribed from the heterogeneous-properties column H [J/g] of NASA TP-1906 Table 11.3E for H/C=2.000, F/A=0.084535, equivalence ratio=1.250, chemical equivalence ratio=1.2496, dry air, and 101.325 kPa. H is the published specific enthalpy of the equilibrium heterogeneous mixture. It remains a separate source from the TP-1907 Table 11.3E composition rows and is converted to a local extensive target only through the reviewed executable inventory mass.

quantities.meaning: published fuel to dry-air mass ratio
no added water in reactant air
